title: Distributional Limits for Eigenvalues of Graphon Kernel Matrices
summary: We study eigenvalue fluctuations of kernel and adjacency matrices in dense graphon-based random graph models, for modes associated with simple, isolated nonzero eigenvalues of the graphon integral operator. Our results require no smoothness or Lipschitz continuity. They include degenerate non-leading modes whose normalized eigenfunctions have constant modulus and change sign between $-1$ and $+1$ on measurable sets.
